appearance_facts.fact: The chart title reads 'Increasing Production at Factory F from 2018 to 2023'.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Production' and runs from 0 at the bottom to 3,500 near the top.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' with tick labels 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023 from left to right.
A single blue line connects one point per year, descending from the 2018 point near the top-left to the 2023 point lower on the right.
The 2018 data point is the highest on the line, positioned just below the 3,500 gridline.
The 2023 data point is the lowest on the line, positioned below the 2,000 gridline and above the 1,500 gridline.
Each intermediate year's point lies below the prior year's point and above the following year's point, forming a continuous downward slope.
The line never rises from left to right; it steps down at every year boundary.
